summary: @servicetitan/responsive preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (pinned to v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (rotated string/charcode array with a `WV8StW` shift dispatcher, `_0x`-prefixed mangled identifiers, and a large opaque constant table for runtime string reconstruction). Its filename bears no relation to the package's advertised purpose (a React responsive-component library under the `@servicetitan` scope), and no file under `dist/` imports it — its only reachable use is the preinstall execution path. The React component tree in `dist/` appears to serve as camouflage around this dropper. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope with repository metadata pointing at `github.com/servicetitan/application-ui` and a peer dependency on `@servicetitan/design-system`, presenting itself as a legitimate ServiceTitan design-system component while its only substantive install-time effect is executing the obfuscated Bun payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
